tunnel.upgrade.client.label.note: HTTP 426 means this connector cannot bootstrap the server's relay-only protocol, not an authentication, network or billing problem. The supervisor parks instead of retrying. No width budget is imposed.

tunnel.upgrade.client.guidance.role: Shell exception, connector/status detail and TUI setup remedy
tunnel.upgrade.client.guidance.note: Locally authored mapping for HTTP 426; never copies server bodies. Preserve technical tokens config.yml and all placeholders exactly. update_command is lop update on the shell or /update in the TUI; reconnect_command is lop tunnel connect on the shell or /mobile enable in the TUI. override is the literal tunnel.transport: cloudflare. The override may be absent: do not instruct enabling Cloudflare or imply login/billing changes help. A first supported version is not yet assigned; rollout remains gated on an actual capability-advertising release and fleet verification.

tunnel.upgrade.client.plain.role: Graphical setup/status guidance without shell commands
tunnel.upgrade.client.plain.note: Same permanent HTTP 426 state for surfaces without a terminal. Preserve Local Operator, Radient, config.yml and tunnel.transport: cloudflare as technical/product tokens. This is a manual update/configuration/reconnect prerequisite, not a retry/login/billing action. No button or automatic update is implied.
